promote_guide.what_effect_verification_gives: T-0034 makes the grant-resolver effect-aware on the invoke path. When the composition root wires an EffectSource (the effect-resource DAO port), any mcp_tool invocation with a non-empty declares list must be backed by an effect_resource grant for every declared (kind, resourceId) pair. Pure-compute tools (empty declares) pass unchanged. The verification is additive: the existing record-grant step 1-4 runs first; step 3.5 only activates when deps.effects is present. This gives operators fine-grained control: an agent may hold a normal 'invoke' grant on a tool handle but still be denied if it declares an effect on an integration_endpoint or messaging_channel for which it holds no effect grant.

promote_guide.migration_022_summary: CREATE TABLE choros.effect_resource (tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, id UUID NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('integration_endpoint','messaging_channel','storage_bucket','external_api')), name TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id)). ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; policy: tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')::uuid. GRANT SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE TO choros_app. No cross-table FK (self-contained per T-0017 lesson). effect_resource added to known_tenant_tables.txt.

promote_guide.trust_boundary_nit_R1: Nit R-1 addressed in commit 8c4d7d2: comment at grant-resolver.ts:406 now documents that EffectSource present + invokeCtx absent defaults declares=[] and proceeds as pure-compute. This is distinct from the NF-2 backward-compat floor (EffectSource absent ⇒ entire step 3.5 skipped). Composition-root authors must always supply invokeCtx when invoking an mcp_tool handle; omitting it bypasses effect verification by design (ADR §4.4 option 2).
promote_guide.downstream_note: T-0034 adds the effect-resource seam for T-0043 (7 exports below). The EffectSource port is wired at the composition root; the DB-backed DAO (T-0053) activates the floor in production. No new services or docker-compose changes; migration 022 is additive.

downstream_T0043.description: T-0043 will import from src/core/effect-resource.ts. All 7 public exports must be treated as stable contract — do not rename or change signatures without a DESIGN-phase ADR amendment.

exports.name: EffectKind
exports.description: Closed union of effect resource categories: 'integration_endpoint' | 'messaging_channel' | 'storage_bucket' | 'external_api'

exports.name: EffectDeclaration
exports.description: A tool's typed claim to invoke one effect-resource: { kind: EffectKind; resourceId: string }

exports.name: EffectResource
exports.description: First-class effect-resource entity row: { id: string; tenantId: string; kind: EffectKind; name: string; description?: string; createdAt: Date }

exports.name: EffectSource
exports.description: Port for resolving effect-resource by id within a tenant — injected at composition root, DB-backed DAO lands with T-0053

exports.name: ToolEffectProfile
exports.description: Result of classifyTool: { pure: true } for empty declares, or { pure: false; effects: EffectDeclaration[] } for valid/malformed input

exports.name: classifyTool
exports.description: Pure function — classifies a raw declares blob: empty array → pure:true; non-empty valid → pure:false effects:[...]; malformed/null/unknown-kind → pure:false effects:[]

exports.name: verifyEffectGrants
exports.description: Pure function — verifies all EffectDeclarations are covered by valid effect_resource grants in the grant set; returns { ok: true } or { ok: false; missingResourceId: string }

known_issues.component: ci/checks/db/schema.test.ts :: FF-ACT :: zero ACT_* tables exist
known_issues.description: schema.test.ts counts all information_schema.tables WHERE table_name LIKE 'act_%' without a schema filter. When Flowable is co-started with Postgres in the same compose project (e.g. COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME=choros-t0034-test), Flowable creates 56 ACT_* tables in the 'flowable' schema — the test expects 0 and fails. schema.test.ts was NOT modified in any T-0034 build commit; the same failure occurs on dev when Flowable co-starts.
known_issues.recommendation: For fitness:db runs start only the postgres service, not the full docker-compose stack (i.e. docker compose up -d postgres, not docker compose up -d). Alternatively add 'AND table_schema NOT IN (''flowable'')' to the schema.test query. Fix can be batched into T-0053 or a dedicated tooling task.
